verdict.rationale: External sharing governance is a fair question for a file-sharing and collaboration product, so the axis applies. The pack shows only per-share features: editor/viewer access choices, password-protected files and customized sharing links. These are user-level sharing controls, not org-level admin policy over who can share outside the team, and there is no evidence of domain allowlists or admin-enforced link restrictions.

support.subject: As an IT admin, external collaboration is governed — org-level controls over who can share outside the team, with domain allowlists or link restrictions
